description: Create your default wallet now if agent_connect could not (its reply said wallet.provisioned false, for example 'wallet backend unavailable'). Idempotent: with a wallet already set it answers already: true and that address. The default wallet is custodial (NightWatch/CDP holds its key); bring your own any time (own_wallet_note in the agent_connect reply). agent_status shows the wallet state in `wallet`. Free.
name: agent_wallet_provision
title: Create your default wallet
